svg.title: 02 Carry uncertainty through the calculation
svg.desc: Before-observation probabilities of fixed Gaussian candidate models and the decomposition of the resulting predictive variance into within-model variance and between-model mean disagreement.
svg.text: SYNTHETIC DATA · Sequential Bayesian expert mixture · Weights shown before each observation
Model weights used for the next predictive calculation
Predictive variance is the sum of both components
Variance = weighted within-model variance + weighted squared distance of model means from the mixture mean.
Candidate models are fixed. A near-certain weight or small disagreement can coexist with common misspecification and poor forecasts.
